name: THE HUB Higashi-Nihonbashi
card: Private offices for 1–4 in Higashi-Nihonbashi, served by four stations
title: THE HUB Higashi-Nihonbashi — a rental office of private rooms for 1–4, on floors 5–7 of the Sanko Nihonbashi Plaza Building
lead: THE HUB Higashi-Nihonbashi is on the 5th to 7th floors of the Sanko Nihonbashi Plaza Building, a three-minute walk from Higashi-Nihonbashi Station on the Toei Asakusa Line. It has private offices for 1–4 people, a meeting space, a lounge and dedicated mailboxes. Four stations — Higashi-Nihonbashi, Bakuro-yokoyama, Bakurocho and Ningyocho — are within reach. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Private offices (1–4 people) / meeting space (up to 30 min per use) / lounge / dedicated mailboxes
Founders, licensed professionals and small companies
concept: Private offices for small teams
The website advertises “private offices from the ¥30,000s” and describes it as a base for founders, licensed professionals and small companies.
Rooms for 1 to 4 people line the 5th to 7th floors, all furnished and with internet. Access to several lines is another feature.
steps: The meeting space can be used for up to 30 minutes at a time, and there is a lounge.
It is three minutes from Higashi-Nihonbashi and Bakuro-yokoyama stations.
Private rooms for 1 to 4 people are on the 5th, 6th and 7th floors, all furnished and with internet.
Availability changes over time, so check the official website.
An office that can receive mail
There are private rooms on the 7th floor too.
Tenants get a dedicated mailbox, so the office can receive business mail.

word.title: What is the meeting space?
body: A place for short meetings. At THE HUB Higashi-Nihonbashi it can be used for up to 30 minutes at a time.
Limiting the time lets tenants share a meeting place even in a small site.

credits: THE HUB official website: “THE HUB Higashi-Nihonbashi”

name: SENQ Aoyama Namiki-dori
card: 3rd floor of the Daiichi Hoki headquarters, themed BUILD NEXT CULTURES
title: SENQ Aoyama Namiki-dori — a “BUILD NEXT CULTURES” workplace for pioneers, on the 3rd floor of the Daiichi Hoki headquarters
lead: SENQ Aoyama Namiki-dori is on the 3rd floor of the Daiichi Hoki headquarters building, a four-minute walk from Aoyama-itchome and Gaiemmae stations. Its theme is “BUILD NEXT CULTURES” — a place where pioneers gather to create new values and cultures that will shape the next generation of innovation, the website says. It has a lounge, a café corner, 18 rooms, 20 solo booths and 3 meeting booths. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Lounge / café corner / 18 rooms (6.71–98.52 m²) / 20 solo booths / 3 meeting booths (4 people, wall-mounted monitor)
concept: BUILD NEXT CULTURES
SENQ Aoyama Namiki-dori's theme is “BUILD NEXT CULTURES” — a place where pioneers gather to create new values and cultures that influence the next generation of innovation, the website says.
While SENQ Aoyama nearby accepts room members only, Aoyama Namiki-dori also takes coworking members and drop-ins.
steps: From the 3rd-floor reception, the lounge opens up.
Coworking is ¥22,000 a month and drop-in ¥550 an hour, available 9:00–22:00 on weekdays.
There are 18 rooms ranging from 6.71 m² to 98.52 m², from ¥137,500 a month.
There is also a refresh area for tenants only.
There are 20 solo booths from ¥82,500 a month; drop-in users can book one for ¥1,100 an hour.
Three meeting booths for 4 have wall-mounted monitors.

word.title: What does BUILD NEXT CULTURES mean?
body: “Build the next cultures” — SENQ Aoyama Namiki-dori takes these words as its theme.
In Aoyama, a source of trends and culture, it aims to be a place where people who create new values gather.

name: CROSSCOOP Shinjuku SOUTH
card: High-grade private offices with 15 meeting rooms, one minute from Shinjuku-sanchome
title: CROSSCOOP Shinjuku SOUTH — a rental office with 15 meeting rooms on the 3rd, 5th and 6th floors of the Hulic Shinjuku 4-chome Building
lead: CROSSCOOP Shinjuku SOUTH is on the 3rd, 5th and 6th floors of the Hulic Shinjuku 4-chome Building (formerly FORECAST Shinjuku SOUTH), a one-minute walk from Shinjuku-sanchome Station on the Tokyo Metro and four from the South Exit of Shinjuku Station. Billed as “a rental office for flexible working with Shinjuku as your base”, it has high-grade private rooms where you can register your company and 15 meeting rooms. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: CROSSCOOP Shinjuku SOUTH rental office by TKP
Private rooms (3–57 people) / 15 meeting rooms / lounges (3F, 6F) / TELECUBE web-meeting booths (3F, 6F) / seminar room (54)
concept: Flexible working in Shinjuku
The website describes it as “a rental office for flexible working with Shinjuku as your base”, with high-grade private rooms that allow company registration, 15 meeting rooms and a staffed reception.
It uses three floors — the 3rd, 5th and 6th — with private rooms from 3 to 57 people. Shared facilities are open 24 hours.
steps: The office entrance on the 5th floor has a reception desk staffed 9:00–18:00 on weekdays.
Lounges are on the 3rd and 6th floors.
There are 15 meeting rooms across the three floors, for 4 to 10 people.
TELECUBE web-meeting booths are on the 3rd and 6th floors.
Private rooms range from 3 to 57 people. A room for 5 is ¥425,000 a month and a room for 10 ¥850,000 (excluding tax).
Some rooms have windows, and larger rooms come with their own phone booths.
The building has a seminar room for 54.
Training sessions and briefings can be held in the same building.

word.title: What is a TELECUBE?
body: A box-shaped private booth for online meetings and calls. CROSSCOOP Shinjuku SOUTH has TELECUBEs on its 3rd and 6th floors.
You can focus on web meetings without worrying about noise from the lounge or offices.

name: CROSSCOOP Shimbashi
card: A 96-seat lounge and private rooms for up to 100, two minutes from Uchisaiwaicho
title: CROSSCOOP Shimbashi — a 96-seat lounge and high-grade private rooms with company registration, in the Urbannet Uchisaiwaicho Building
lead: CROSSCOOP Shimbashi is in the Urbannet Uchisaiwaicho Building, two minutes from exit A5 of Uchisaiwaicho Station and four from Shimbashi Station. Across the 3rd to 5th floors are a lounge of about 96 seats, eight meeting rooms, web booths, a coworking space, a seminar room for 72 and private rooms for 10 to 100 people. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Lounge (about 96 seats) / 8 meeting rooms (8–10 people) / web booths / coworking space / seminar room (72) / private rooms (10–100 people)
concept: High-grade private offices with company registration

The website describes it as “a high-grade private office with company registration, meeting rooms and full facilities”, highlighting face-recognition security and a building prepared for business continuity (BCP).
Private rooms for 10 to 100 people are combined with a 96-seat lounge and a coworking space. Contracts start from one month.
steps: Eight meeting rooms and a room for 72
There is one meeting room for 8 and seven for 10. Private-room contracts include free meeting-room hours.
There is also a seminar room for 72.
Private rooms range from 10 to 100 people. A room for 10 is ¥1,010,000 a month and a room for 45 is ¥4,500,000.
Even a large company's base fits on a single floor.

word.title: What is BCP?
body: Short for Business Continuity Plan: preparations to keep working even when disasters strike. The website says CROSSCOOP Shimbashi is in a building prepared for BCP.
When large companies choose a base, how well the building is prepared is an important condition.

name: WeWork Marunouchi Kitaguchi
card: Connected to Tokyo and Otemachi stations, with a different lounge on each of floors 7–11
title: WeWork Marunouchi Kitaguchi — a flexible office on floors 7–11 of the Marunouchi Kitaguchi Building, directly connected to Tokyo Station
lead: WeWork Marunouchi Kitaguchi is on the 7th to 11th floors of the Marunouchi Kitaguchi Building, directly connected to Tokyo and Otemachi stations. Built around the concept of a relaxing space, it has a lounge with a different concept on each floor and lots of sofa seating. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Completed August 2004 / 29 floors above ground, 4 below
Ceiling height 2,800 mm / 35 meeting rooms / phone booths, parents' room, honesty market and more
concept: A different lounge on every floor
WeWork Marunouchi Kitaguchi's concept is “a space to relax”. Each floor has a lounge with its own concept, with lots of sofa seating, the website says.
The shared areas use a lively colour palette, creating spaces that feel bright yet calm.
steps: There are 35 meeting rooms, plus phone booths, a parents' room and an honesty market.
The website says there are many private offices for anything from one person to several hundred, and it can accommodate whole floors and custom requests.
The ground floor of the building has shops, restaurants and a supermarket.

word.title: What is a flexible office?
body: An office where the size and contract can change flexibly with headcount and timeframe. WeWork describes its sites this way.
Contracts are shorter than ordinary office leases, and shared lounges and meeting rooms come with them.

name: WeWork Kamiyacho Trust Tower
card: One of WeWork's largest sites in Japan, with interiors reflecting Toranomon past and present
title: WeWork Kamiyacho Trust Tower — one of the largest WeWork sites in Japan, on floors 21–24, directly connected to Kamiyacho Station
lead: WeWork Kamiyacho Trust Tower is on the 21st to 24th floors of Kamiyacho Trust Tower, the core of Tokyo World Gate, completed in 2020. The website calls it one of the largest sites in Japan, and highlights art and interiors built around the past and present of Toranomon. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Completed March 2020 / 38 floors above ground, 3 below
Ceiling height 2,900–3,000 mm / 56 meeting rooms / phone booths, parents' room, honesty market and more
hero_cap: The shared area at WeWork Kamiyacho Trust Tower
concept: Toranomon, past and present
The interior concept is “Toranomon, past and present”. In an open space that takes in Japanese elements, style and playfulness coexist, the website says.

It is directly connected to Kamiyacho Station on the subway and within walking distance of Toranomon, Toranomon Hills and Roppongi-itchome stations. Several other WeWork sites are nearby, and members move between them often.
steps: The shared areas are open and take in Japanese elements.
Ceilings of 2,900–3,000 mm let you feel the spaciousness of the high floors.
There are 56 meeting rooms — a very large number for one site.
Phone booths, a parents' room and an honesty market are also available.

word.title: Why does ceiling height matter?
body: The distance from floor to ceiling. In office buildings, around 2,700 mm is a common benchmark.
At WeWork Kamiyacho Trust Tower, ceilings are 2,900–3,000 mm, so the same floor area feels more spacious.

credits: WeWork official website: “WeWork Kamiyacho Trust Tower”

name: WeWork Hibiya FORT TOWER
card: A large site on floors 4–11, themed “Metabolism”
title: WeWork Hibiya FORT TOWER — Metabolism-inspired interiors across floors 4–11, served by 12 lines at four stations
lead: WeWork Hibiya FORT TOWER is on the 4th to 11th floors of Hibiya Fort Tower, served by 12 lines at four stations: Kasumigaseki, Uchisaiwaicho, Toranomon and Shimbashi. Its interior concept is “Metabolism”, describing cities and buildings that grow organically. It also offers SOHO units that are more private and secure than usual. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Completed June 2021 / 27 floors above ground, 2 below
Ceiling height 2,800–3,000 mm / 29 meeting rooms / SOHO units / phone booths, parents' room and more
concept: Metabolism
The interior concept is “Metabolism” — a word, the website says, for cities and architecture that grow organically as society changes and develops.
The site itself spans floors 4 to 11 and is built to expand: from a few people up to large offices of more than 100.
steps: Hot desks and a community bar
The 10th floor has a shared hot-desk area and a community bar.
It is close to Hibiya Park and the Imperial Hotel, in an area rich in amenities.
A large site spanning eight floors, from the 4th to the 11th, it can host offices from a few people to over 100.
Phone booths, a parents' room and an honesty market are also available.

word.title: What was Metabolism?
body: An architectural movement proposed by Japanese architects in the 1960s, holding that cities and buildings should change and grow like the metabolism of a living thing.
WeWork Hibiya FORT TOWER takes it as its interior concept.

credits: WeWork official website: “WeWork Hibiya FORT TOWER”

name: WeWork KANDA SQUARE
card: A large site with art inspired by Akihabara's Electric Town and retro video games
title: WeWork KANDA SQUARE — a large site themed on Akihabara's Electric Town and retro video games
lead: With reception on the 11th floor of KANDA SQUARE in Kanda-Nishikicho, WeWork KANDA SQUARE is a large site with many private offices for anything from 2 to several hundred people. Its interior theme is Akihabara's Electric Town, with art inspired by retro video games scattered throughout. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Completed February 2020 / 21 floors above ground, 1 below
Ceiling height 2,900 mm / 45 meeting rooms / phone booths, parents' room, honesty market and more
hero_cap: The shared area at WeWork KANDA SQUARE
concept: Akihabara's Electric Town and retro games
The interior theme is Akihabara's Electric Town, with art inspired by old video games scattered throughout the space.
The website describes a site at the centre of culture and trends: Kanda Myojin shrine and the Kanda Festival, Akihabara's Electric Town and Jimbocho's second-hand book fairs.
steps: Art inspired by retro video games is scattered through the shared areas.
From 2 to several hundred, with backup power
There are many private offices for 2 to several hundred people.
The building has seismic isolation and dampers, and in a power cut its emergency generator can supply air-conditioning, lighting and outlets in tenant areas for up to about 15 days.

word.title: What are BCP measures?
body: BCP stands for Business Continuity Plan: preparations to keep working through disasters and power cuts.
KANDA SQUARE has, among other things, an emergency generator that can supply power for about 15 days continuously when running on city gas.

name: WeWork D Tower Nishi-Shinjuku
card: Modernism as the concept — calm high floors in shades of wood
title: WeWork D Tower Nishi-Shinjuku — high floors of Modernism and wood tones, 4 minutes from Nishi-Shinjuku Station
lead: WeWork D Tower Nishi-Shinjuku is on the 16th floor of D Tower Nishi-Shinjuku, a four-minute walk from Nishi-Shinjuku Station on the Marunouchi Line. Its interior takes Modernism as its concept, using light and dark wood to create a calm space. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Completed March 2020 / 29 floors above ground, 2 below
Ceiling height 2,850 mm / 20 meeting rooms / phone booths, parents' room, honesty market and more
concept: Modernism and shades of wood
The interior concept is Modernism: a calm space design inspired by great architects, making use of light and dark wood, the website says.
On a high floor, it also has views from the windows. Close to Shinjuku's top hotels and sightseeing areas, it is a convenient place to welcome guests from overseas.
steps: By the windows on a high floor
On a high floor, it offers views from the windows.
There are 20 meeting rooms, plus phone booths and a parents' room.
More than 200 seats can be used on a single floor, from project teams up to a full head-office move.
The building has shops and a childcare facility.

word.title: What is Modernism?
body: A 20th-century movement in architecture and design that restrains decoration and shows function and materials honestly.
WeWork D Tower Nishi-Shinjuku takes Modernism as its interior concept and ties the space together with shades of wood.

credits: WeWork official website: “WeWork D Tower Nishi-Shinjuku”
